case_name: Baijnath Mahton and Others v State of Bihar
respondent:
State of Bihar
Supreme Court of India

13 July 1993
Cr.A. No. 910 of 1981 (From the Judgment and Order Dt. 5 February 1981 of the Patna High Court in Cr. A. No. 90 of 1975)
The Judgment was delivered by:  K. JAYACHANDRA REDDY, J.
1.  There are seven appellants. They along with three
facts: There are seven appellants. They along with three others were tried for offences punishable under Section 302 read with 34 and also under section 147 IPC.
The accused, two deceased persons in the case and the material witnesses belong to Mahjiladih Village in Hazaribagh District.
A piece of land - plot No. 866 was the subject-matter of dispute between appellant I and the prosecution party.
On August 29, 1969 PW 3 and his men were engaged in agricultural operation in that land.

The plea of the accused was that they were in possession of plot No. 866 and on the day of occurrence the two deceased persons along with others armed came there to dispossess them and also inflicted injuries on two of the accused persons.
issues: Whether the accused had a right of private defence of property and person
Whether the accused exceeded the right of private defence
petitioner_arguments: The accused cannot be expected to weigh the same in golden scales and modulate their defence
court_reasoning: We are in agreement with the finding of the High Court.
Having gone through the record we think that the ends of justice would be met if the sentence is reduced to two years' RI.
holding: Subject to this modification of sentence, the appeal is dismissed.
